ashOfRemembrance.flavor: The dead lend strength. They are not gentle about it.
ashOfRemembrance.name: Ash of Remembrance
ashOfRemembrance.textTemplate: Gain {gainEnergy} extra Energy each turn. At the start of each combat, gain {madness} Madness.

ashenGrip.flavor: The leather remembers every hand that held it, and gives a little back.
ashenGrip.name: Ashen Grip
ashenGrip.textTemplate: The first stance you enter each turn refunds {restoreStamina} Stamina.

azureSigil.flavor: Painted in a hand that trembled, by someone who steadied at the last stroke.
azureSigil.name: Azure Sigil
azureSigil.textTemplate: The first Skill you play each combat: gain {gainEnergy} Energy.

blessedDew.flavor: It gathers on the vial overnight, from nowhere, for no one.
blessedDew.name: Blessed Dew
blessedDew.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, heal {heal} HP.

blightTouchedIdol.flavor: The carving was of a saint. The blight made it a saint of something else.
blightTouchedIdol.name: Blight-Touched Idol
blightTouchedIdol.textTemplate: Your first attack each combat applies {crimsonBlight} Crimson Blight.

bloodiedTalisman.name: Bloodied Talisman
bloodiedTalisman.textTemplate: Whenever Bleed bursts, the victim loses {loseHp} additional HP.

bloodstainedChalice.flavor: It fills a little more each time. You have stopped asking with what.
bloodstainedChalice.name: Bloodstained Chalice
bloodstainedChalice.textTemplate: Whenever Bleed bursts on an enemy, gain {block} Block.

carrionMorsel.flavor: The spire feeds those who feed it. It is not fussy about the manners of the exchange.
carrionMorsel.name: Carrion Morsel
carrionMorsel.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy dies, heal {heal} HP.

carrionTalon.flavor: The flock does not mourn. The flock moves to the next warm thing.
carrionTalon.name: Carrion Talon
carrionTalon.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy dies, deal {damage} damage to a random enemy.

cinderOfTheFallen.flavor: It pays out in the coin of endings. It expects you to make more of them.
cinderOfTheFallen.name: Cinder of the Fallen
cinderOfTheFallen.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy dies, gain {gainEnergy} Energy. At the start of each combat, gain {madness} Madness.

crackedLantern.flavor: The glass is broken but the flame refuses to notice.
crackedLantern.name: Cracked Lantern
crackedLantern.textTemplate: On your first turn each combat, gain {gainEnergy} Energy.

crimsonCovenant.flavor: The pact is simple: your blood answers for theirs. It is not a fair trade, but it is fast.
crimsonCovenant.name: Crimson Covenant
crimsonCovenant.textTemplate: Your attacks apply {bleed} Bleed. At the start of each combat, lose {loseHp} HP.

crownOfStitches.flavor: It fits. That is the worst part.
crownOfStitches.name: Crown of Stitches
crownOfStitches.textTemplate: Begin each combat with {strength} Strength — and {frail} Frail. New limbs are heavy.

curedHide.flavor: The beast learned its lesson too late to keep it.
curedHide.name: Cured Hide
curedHide.textTemplate: The first time you lose HP each combat, gain {block} Block. Poise threshold +2 (no current consumer).

cutpursesCoin.flavor: One face buys silence. The other buys speed.
cutpursesCoin.name: Cutpurse's Coin
cutpursesCoin.textTemplate: Begin each combat Prepared. Your first attack each combat applies {venom} Venom.

emberIdol.flavor: It has been warm to the touch for a thousand years. It is patient about it.
emberIdol.name: Ember Idol
emberIdol.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, deal {damage} damage to ALL enemies.

emberwickCharm.flavor: It burns brightest at the moment you can least afford to slow down.
emberwickCharm.name: Emberwick Charm
emberwickCharm.textTemplate: The first time you lose HP each combat, gain {gainEnergy} Energy.

fellWardenBrand.name: Fell Warden Brand
fellWardenBrand.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy Staggers, draw {draw} cards.

feralEye.name: Feral Eye
feralEye.textTemplate: Elites offer an extra card reward choice.

flayersCenser.flavor: The smoke seeks out lungs. It is not particular about whose.
flayersCenser.name: Flayer's Censer
flayersCenser.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, apply {crimsonBlight} Crimson Blight to ALL enemies.

forsakenMedallion.flavor: Its face is worn smooth, but it still remembers being gold.
forsakenMedallion.name: Forsaken Medallion
forsakenMedallion.textTemplate: Max HP +{hpFlat}. Your first attack each combat also deals {poiseDamage} Poise damage.

forsakenWarflag.flavor: The colors are all but rotted away. What it musters now answers to no banner but yours.
forsakenWarflag.name: Forsaken Warflag
forsakenWarflag.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, apply {weak} Weak to ALL enemies.

gildedTear.flavor: A single drop, hardened gold, wept for someone who never asked for it.
gildedTear.name: Gilded Tear
gildedTear.textTemplate: On your first turn each combat, heal {heal} HP.

goldFigurine.flavor: It is very small and very heavy and it loves you.
goldFigurine.name: Gold Figurine
goldFigurine.textTemplate: Whenever you heal, gain {block} Block (even at full HP).

goldboughSapling.name: Goldbough Sapling
goldboughSapling.textTemplate: At the start of your turn, if you have no Block: gain {block} Block.

goldenSprout.flavor: A sapling waits inside, patient as grief.
goldenSprout.name: Golden Sprout
goldenSprout.textTemplate: At the start of each combat, heal {heal} HP.

goldleafCharm.flavor: A single leaf, pressed flat, still gold. It keeps the wind off you.
goldleafCharm.name: Goldleaf Charm
goldleafCharm.textTemplate: At the start of your first turn, gain {block} Block.

gravetendersBell.flavor: One toll for each name laid down. The tending is in the counting.
gravetendersBell.name: Gravetender's Bell
gravetendersBell.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy dies, draw {draw} card.

hollowedHorn.flavor: It sounds only once. Everything still standing flinches.
hollowedHorn.name: Hollowed Horn
hollowedHorn.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy Staggers, apply {vulnerable} Vulnerable to ALL enemies.

howlingStandard.flavor: It has not fallen in a hundred routs. It does not intend to start with yours.
howlingStandard.name: Howling Standard
howlingStandard.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy Staggers, gain {strength} Strength.

ivoryComb.flavor: Someone kept themselves tidy right up until the end.
ivoryComb.name: Ivory Comb
ivoryComb.textTemplate: Every 8th card you play each combat: draw {draw} card.

kindlingCharm.name: Kindling Charm
kindlingCharm.textTemplate: At the start of each combat, draw {draw} extra card.

lodestarShard.flavor: It points nowhere on any map. It points at the next cast.
lodestarShard.name: Lodestar Shard
lodestarShard.textTemplate: Begin each combat with {restoreMana} extra Mana.

moonlitVial.flavor: It never empties. It never fills, either.
moonlitVial.name: Moonlit Vial
moonlitVial.textTemplate: At the start of each combat, gain {block} Block.

paupersDiadem.flavor: The crown accepts your future earnings. It never asks what you will eat.
paupersDiadem.name: Pauper's Diadem
paupersDiadem.textTemplate: Power cards cost 1 less (minimum 0). Gain 35% fewer Cinders from combats.

pearlOfSagacity.flavor: It clouds when you are foolish. It has been cloudy for some time.
pearlOfSagacity.name: Pearl of Sagacity
pearlOfSagacity.textTemplate: Every 6th card you play each combat: gain {gainEnergy} Energy.

prismaticThorn.flavor: It drinks the medicine and leaves the fever bright.
prismaticThorn.name: Prismatic Thorn
prismaticThorn.textTemplate: Your hits build 25% more Arcane Exposure. Flasks are 25% weaker (rounded up).

radiantAegis.flavor: It rewards the guarded. It has nothing to say to the reckless.
radiantAegis.name: Radiant Aegis
radiantAegis.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, if you have Block: gain {block} Block.

restlessClasp.flavor: It keeps the medicine close and sleep far away.
restlessClasp.name: Restless Clasp
restlessClasp.textTemplate: Flasks are 100% stronger. Resting heals 50% less.

sacrificialKnife.flavor: It was made to open things that were meant to stay closed.
sacrificialKnife.name: Sacrificial Knife
sacrificialKnife.textTemplate: Your first attack each combat applies {bleed} Bleed.

saltedRelic.flavor: It was buried to keep something in, or something out. No one remembers which.
saltedRelic.name: Salted Relic

sealstoneKey.name: Sealstone Key
sealstoneKey.textTemplate: Unknown (?) locations on the map are revealed.

sentinelsOath.flavor: The oath is long and the watch is longer. Endurance is its own kind of edge.
sentinelsOath.name: Sentinel's Oath
sentinelsOath.textTemplate: Every 12th card you play each combat: gain {strength} Strength.

starstoneShard.flavor: A chip of someone else’s genius. It still hums.
starstoneShard.name: Starstone Shard
starstoneShard.textTemplate: Mana +{manaFlat}. Magic damage +{magicDamageFlat}. Begin each combat with Starstone Charge and restore {restoreMana} Mana.

titansCinder.flavor: A giant died to make this. It is still furious about it.
titansCinder.name: Titan's Cinder
titansCinder.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, gain {strength} Strength.

travelersWhetstone.flavor: It was sharpened by hands that are no longer here to use it.
travelersWhetstone.name: Traveler's Whetstone
travelersWhetstone.textTemplate: At the start of each combat, gain {strength} Strength.

twinnedArmor.name: Twinned Armor
twinnedArmor.textTemplate: Every 10th card you play each combat: gain {block} Block.

vigilantHalo.flavor: It hovers a hand above your head, waiting for you to earn it.
vigilantHalo.name: Vigilant Halo
vigilantHalo.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy Staggers, heal {heal} HP.

vowOfVengeance.flavor: Every name you take is a name you carry.
vowOfVengeance.name: Vow of Vengeance
vowOfVengeance.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy dies, gain {strength} Strength.

wardenHorn.flavor: It sounds without being blown. Something is answering.
wardenHorn.name: Warden Horn
wardenHorn.textTemplate: Draw {draw} extra card each turn. At the start of each combat, lose {loseHp} HP.

wardensLantern.flavor: The flame gutters when you are hurt, then burns a little brighter.
wardensLantern.name: Warden's Lantern
wardensLantern.textTemplate: The first time you lose HP each combat, draw {draw} card.

warhorn.flavor: One long note, and the old anger answers.
warhorn.name: Warhorn
warhorn.textTemplate: At the start of each combat, gain {strength} Strength.

watchmansBadge.flavor: It is pinned to a coat that has seen more watches than the man wearing it.
watchmansBadge.name: Watchman's Badge
watchmansBadge.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, if you are not Weak: gain {strength} Strength.

waxenSeal.flavor: Pressed once, it holds. Pressed twice, it is only wax.
waxenSeal.name: Waxen Seal
waxenSeal.textTemplate: The first time you heal each combat, heal {heal} more.

wayfarersKnot.flavor: One knot for the road ahead. One for the breath to walk it.
wayfarersKnot.name: Wayfarer's Knot
wayfarersKnot.textTemplate: Gain 10% more Cinders from combats. Resting heals 10% more.

whetstoneFragment.name: Whetstone Fragment
whetstoneFragment.textTemplate: Your first attack each combat deals {damage} extra damage.

whetstonePouch.flavor: A thumb along the edge before the first cut. Habit, and then not.
whetstonePouch.name: Whetstone Pouch
whetstonePouch.textTemplate: Your first attack while Prepared each combat applies {bleed} Bleed.

wrathCoil.flavor: It winds tighter with every wound and lets go all at once, at someone else.
wrathCoil.name: Wrath Coil
wrathCoil.textTemplate: Whenever you lose HP, deal {damage} damage to a random enemy.

wyrmHeart.flavor: It still beats. It expects something of you.
wyrmHeart.name: Wyrm Heart
wyrmHeart.textTemplate: Gain {gainEnergy} extra Energy each turn. Shrines and chapels no longer offer Rest.
